examples.text: De politie kon de agressieve <w>schopper</w> snel overmeesteren na het incident op het plein.

target_lang_translations.en: The police were able to quickly overpower the aggressive <w>kicker</w> after the incident on the square.

examples.text: Als bekende <w>schopper</w> tegen de gevestigde orde kreeg de columnist veel kritiek.

target_lang_translations.en: As a well-known <w>rebel</w> against the established order, the columnist received a lot of criticism.

target_lang_definitions.en: someone who kicks, either literally with their feet or metaphorically against established norms

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: someone who kicks against the establishment
someone who causes disruption or kicks up a fuss
